preconditions.description: The number of factories N is between 1 and 500,000 inclusive.
The number of businessmen M is between 1 and 500,000 inclusive.
The number of years Q is between 1 and 500,000 inclusive.
The parent list has exactly N-1 elements.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p <= i for i, p in enumerate(parent, start=2))
preconditions.description: Each factory's parent has a lower index than the factory itself.
The list B has exactly N elements.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b <= M for b in B)
preconditions.description: Each factory is owned by a businessman between 1 and M inclusive.
The threshold list has exactly M elements.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= t <= 10**18 for t in threshold)
preconditions.description: Each businessman's threshold is between 1 and 10^18 inclusive.
The donations list has exactly Q elements.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= F <= N for F, X, D in donations)
preconditions.description: Each donation's factory index F is between 1 and N inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= X <= 10**6 for F, X, D in donations)
preconditions.description: Each donation's amount X is between 1 and 1,000,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= D <= 10**6 for F, X, D in donations)
preconditions.description: Each donation's increment D is between 0 and 1,000,000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The result list has exactly M elements.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(year, int) or year == 'rekt' for year in result)
postconditions.description: Each element in the result list is either an integer or the string 'rekt'.

postconditions.expression: all((1 <= year <= Q or year == 'rekt') for year in result)
postconditions.description: Each year in the result list is between 1 and Q inclusive, or 'rekt'.
